## Does OLAPLEX Have a Leave-In Conditioner?


Who doesn’t want hydrated, vibrant, manageable hair? Can a leave-in conditioner help? And does OLAPLEX® make one? Get the answers here, and learn why you might want to add a leave-in conditioner to your routine.


## What Is a Leave-In Conditioner?


A[leave-in, or no-rinse, conditioner](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/all-you-need-to-know-about-leave-ins) is a hair product designed to deliver moisture to your hair and protect against damage. It’s different from regular conditioner and is intended to be left in the hair for an extended time. Leave-in conditioner may also allow for easier styling by hydrating and smoothing the hair shaft. You apply it to wet hair, typically after washing it with shampoo and conditioner, but you can use it anytime. If you have[wavy, curly, or coily hair](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/understanding-your-natural-texture) , it’s a good idea to incorporate one into your hair routine, as these hair types are more prone to breakage and losing moisture. But any[hair type or texture](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/how-to-determine-hair-type-and-texture) can benefit from a leave-in, from fine to[thick, dense hair.](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/thick-vs-dense-hair)


So, does OLAPLEX have a leave-in conditioner? Yes!

2. Rinse[Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/products/n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment) from hair with OLAPLEX Nº.4 Bond Maintenance® Shampoo.
3. Follow up with[N](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us)


[º.5 Bond Maintenance® Conditioner,](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us) applying to mid-lengths and ends. Let sit for 1-3 minutes. Rinse.


4. Pat hair dry.
5. For fine hair, begin with a pump of N


º

6. Follow up with the styling products of your choice. For wavy, curly, and coily hair, try styling with[OLAPLEX N](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-10-bond-shaper-curl-defining-gel-us)

[define your hair pattern](https://olaplex.com/blogs/news/how-to-diffuse-your-hair-for-defined-curls-or-waves) , scrunching upwards.
